faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How are caregivers vetted on the platform?
faq.a1:
Every caregiver profile is manually reviewed before approval.

During the launch phase, the NannyElite team personally checks:

• Identity documents
• References
• Certifications
• Profile information and photos

Only verified profiles are published on the platform.

If information is incomplete or unclear, applicants may be contacted to update or improve their profile before approval.
faq.q2: What happens if my caregiver profile is not approved?
faq.a2:
If a profile does not meet our verification standards, the applicant will receive feedback explaining what needs to be corrected.

Profiles may be declined if:

• Documentation is incomplete
• Information is inconsistent
• References cannot be verified
• Documents appear inaccurate or invalid

Applicants are welcome to resubmit once the requested updates are provided.
faq.a3:
During the launch phase, NannyElite is free to use.

There are currently:

• No subscription fees
• No commissions

Families who find the platform useful may optionally support it through a voluntary donation before contacting a caregiver.

This helps maintain the service while keeping access open and affordable.
faq.q4: How do payments to the nanny work?
faq.a4:
NannyElite connects families and caregivers, but payments are arranged directly between the family and the nanny.

In Switzerland, families employing a nanny may have legal obligations related to:

• Social security contributions (AVS/AI/APG)
• Accident insurance
• Salary declarations

To simplify this process, families may use services such as quitt.ch (https://www.quitt.ch).

Quitt helps manage:

• Nanny payroll
• AVS/AI/APG contributions
• Accident insurance
• Employment contracts
• Salary declarations

This allows families to employ a nanny legally and easily.
faq.q5: Can I meet caregivers before hiring?
faq.a5:
Yes — and we strongly encourage it.

Families should always arrange:

• A video call
• Or an in-person meeting

before making a hiring decision.

This ensures the right fit for both the family and the caregiver.
faq.q6: What if I am not satisfied with a caregiver?
faq.a6:
If you experience any issue, you can contact us at:

info@nannyelite.ch

We will:

• Review the situation
• Provide guidance
• Help you find a better match if needed

Families are also encouraged to leave reviews to help maintain quality across the platform.
faq.q7: Why use NannyElite instead of other platforms?
faq.a7:
NannyElite focuses on quality, trust, and simplicity.

Unlike many large platforms where profiles are automatically published, we review profiles manually during the launch phase.

This approach ensures:

• Verified caregiver profiles
• Higher profile quality
• Transparent reviews
• Direct support from the team

Our goal is not simply to list caregivers, but to create a trusted environment where families can connect with qualified professionals.
faq.q8: How quickly can I find a caregiver?
faq.a8:
Most families receive responses within 24–48 hours, depending on location and availability.

Response times may vary depending on the specific requirements of the job.
faq.a9:
NannyElite currently operates across Switzerland, connecting families and caregivers nationwide.

As demand evolves, we continuously expand both the range of services offered and the areas we cover, adapting to the real needs of families and nannies.

This platform is built for you — and it grows with you.

faq.q13: What makes a profile more likely to be approved?
faq.a13:
Profiles are more likely to be approved quickly if they include:

• Clear, professional profile photo
• Complete bio describing experience and approach
• Detailed work history with age groups
• Valid certifications (first aid, education, etc.)
• Complete reference contact information
• Valid ID document

The more complete your profile, the faster the verification process.
